verdict.rationale: Opting out of vendor telemetry is a fair question for a self-hostable API gateway, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no documented setting or procedure for disabling Kong's own telemetry or usage reporting. The logging and OpenTelemetry export material covers observability of customer traffic, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
